name: Mobile Notifications
summary: The phone as stage: a lock screen buried in banners, then a Live Activity that surfaces one anomaly with a Roll back button.
look: Soft teal-to-peach backdrop, an oversized black phone cropped by the frame, frosted notification banners on a teal-ink wallpaper, a black expanded island as the proof surface and serif headlines in the negative space.

components.name: Oversized device
components.role: concentric corners (outer 112 − bezel 14 = inner 98), cropped larger than the frame

components.name: Island · compact
components.role: black pill with a leading icon and trailing count; teal = watching, coral = alert

components.name: Live Activity
components.role: the expanded island: segment bar, one anomaly line, mono context, two action buttons

components.name: Banner stack
components.role: frosted white r32 banners; newest on top, older ones scale .95 → .90 and fade

components.name: Icon launch
components.role: the Acme mark inside a white screen with concentric echoes, zooming like an app opening

components.name: Island → CTA morph
components.role: the black pill detaches, turns coral and stretches into “Start free”

motion.name: Banner drop
motion.how: y −80 → 0 with slight overshoot, back.out(1.3) 0.35 s, one per beat (0.5 s at 120 BPM)

motion.name: Island stretch
motion.how: width/height spring (stiffness 300, damping 22) ≈ 0.45 s, overshoot 1.04, triggered on a bar downbeat

motion.name: Rolling digits
motion.how: counters roll vertically per digit, 0.3 s power2.out — digits never hard-cut

story: Hook: a lock screen on release-day Friday fills with banners — Checkout looks off, p95 212 ms, error rate 0.4 %, “who’s on call??”, 38 dashboards. Reveal: banners swipe away on the drop and the Acme icon launches into the Acme Pulse screen. Proof: the island expands into a Live Activity watching 14 metrics; one coral segment reads Checkout conversion −18% since 09:42 after deploy #2231 with Roll back and Acknowledge. CTA: the phone slides away and the island morphs into the coral Start free pill.
adapt: Show your product’s real push or widget surface; the Live Activity pattern suits anything with a status that changes over minutes (deploys, deliveries, jobs, incidents).

references.note: Explore Live Activities and the Dynamic Island

fit.risk: Phone UI gets tiny in 1:1; crop tight and resist showing the whole device.
